notes.title: A few asthetic changes...
notes.content: Changed a few NPC animations and repositioned a few objects.

notes.title: Level 2 Bonus Round Update
notes.content: [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281803/fe3722b637ba0b916b7a8b6f2d51690910c4746d.png[/img]Another quick update today. Some sly folks found a bit of a cheat in the Level 2 Bonus Round (Last Rites pit scene vs Gianna), where you can just run into a corner and not take any damage, even though you are technically not moving, effectively bypassing my NoCamping.cs script. Well, now you really do have to keep on moving or you will surely die!

notes.title: Another week, another update...
notes.content: Fixed a few issues and made a few bigger changes. The single punch is now a little snappier, fixed an audio issue with the level transitions, the player's hitbox is now disabled when the level win conditions are met (in rare cases, a player could beat a level then die before the transition to the next one. Thanks go out to everyone playing the arcade cabinet at Last Rites for revealing that issue). I also make the decision to shorten the level 2 bonus round. Two minutes in game really did feel like too much of a marathon. I edited the live perfomance down to make the level 74 seconds long instead of 120. Did a few more tweaks to the player attacks in Level 11, added some more easter eggs to the walls in Levels 1 and 12 (tons of stickers/flyers featuring some of my favorite midwest punk, ska and metal bands).

notes.title: v1.2 Update
notes.content:
Murder Generation: Cream City Chaos v1.2 Update is now live, and the cabinet at Last Rites in Milwaukee will be updated to this build sometime this weekend. It features a complete overhaul of the attack system, replacing the triple punch with a much more responsive single attack, many changes to the enemy AI and animations, a snappier level transition and a complete rebuild of Level 11. When you next play this on Steam, check that you've updated to the build dated August 1st.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281803/b4b010561db6dc7418bf252f3fcf6a952d8b324a.png[/img]

notes.title: Another week of updates.
notes.content: Fixed an issue with the suicide button, removed a delay leading into Level 2, Fixed some other issues where the player could clip through a wall, adjusted some of the UI and added the Cream City Chaos arcade cabinet to the Last Rites levels (it's a real place, and there is a full sized arcade cabinet of this game there). Other additional bug fixes.

notes.title: Notes on v1.1 update
notes.content: Fixed a damage issue with one of the enemies in Level 11. Added low health warning on Level 2.

notes.title: Notes on v1.11 update
notes.content: A few minor bug fixes and now the "1" key on a keyboard will also increase the credit count (some controllers seem to have left and right bumpers that do not increment the credit count).
